Patches.Title: Outskirts Setup Finished, New missions & New Medic System in place + New Gear
Patches.PatchNotes:
## NEW Medical System (new states: heavy bleeding + broken limb)
- Improvised splint
- Aluminium splint
- Compression bandage
- CAT tourniquet
- Adrenaline injector
- Morphine injector
- IFAK
- MFAK

## NEW Gear
- Galvion Caiman ballistic helmet
- IHPS helmet
- Warrior Assault Systems DCS armored rig
- Spiritus Micro Fight chest rig
- Ferro Concepts FCPC V5 plate carrier
- L3 GPNVG-18
- ALICE pack
- Mystery Ranch 3 Day Assault Pack
- SSO Smersh backpack
- Backpacks rolled up version cleaned up

## Outskirts
- Finished the gas station area and its surroundings, including a loot pass, cover, enemy spawns, and patrols.
- Full exterior lighting pass across the map.
- Train station: interior, timetable and fare signs, waiting chairs, a stone bench, and a battered wall with a ramp nearby.
- Started filling out the Shoothouse, and cleaned up the ground and paths around it.
- Adjusted the map boundary.

## Missions and traders (mission briefings are not final and not all recorded yet)
- Added new intro missions 0.5 and 0.75 + new mission between 8 and 9. Moved 2 missions to outskirts. Added 3 new side missions.
- Added intro and context briefings on Quarry, Delta, the Bunker, and Outskirts.
- Added new missions, including sabotage, secure and place, and terminal jobs to Outskirts.
- Added the new boss convoy on Delta. (only at night)
- Added a better tutorial terminal in the hideout.

## Characters and audio
- Added weapon movement sounds, including the MK-47.
- Added sounds for grenades and for the new interaction animations. (new interaction anims for all actions like placing a bomb, accepting operations...)
- Tweaked how gunfire ducks other sounds.

## Other Fixes
- Cheaper weapons lose durability faster.
- Some item stats were rebalanced.
- Barter items are no longer sold on the marketplace. Buy them from the in-raid trader.
- Fixed the TLR-1 HL's position.

Patches.Title: New Attachments
Patches.PatchNotes:
## NEW Attachments
- Aimpoint ACRO P-2 reflex sight
- Trijicon MRO reflex sight
- Elcan SpecterDR 1.5x/6x scope
- Schmidt & Bender 1-8x24 PM II ShortDot scope
- Nightforce ATACR 4-16x42 scope
- AR-15 Odin Works Zulu 2 buttstock
- CMB Helical Baffle 12 gauge muzzle brake
- Rugged Obsidian 9mm suppressor
- L3Harris NGAL laser
- Streamlight TLR-1 HL flashlight
- Wilcox RAPTAR-S laser rangefinder

## Outskirts
- Finished the Northern Warehouse Compound, including a loot pass, enemy spawns, patrols, and an exterior lighting pass.
- Added road barriers along two long side roads, plus cars and other cover along empty roads.
- Added two convoy routes.

## Traders and operations
- Added a trader to the Quarry cave.
- Traders now have proper loadouts.
- All Operations now give rewards (items).

## Audio
- Added dedicated sounds for the MK-47.

## Other Fixes
- Improved performance, including during combat.
- Other players' movement and animations look smoother.
- Fixed Monstera's loadout.
- Fixed mission retracking.
- Fixed issues with convoys, airdrops, and reinforcements.

Patches.Title: Weapon Shadows & Convoy Hitch Fix
Patches.PatchNotes:
## Graphics and interface
- Added first-person weapon shadows.
- Fixed some foliage/trees not really reacting to wind.
- Fixed hitches for convoy.

## Movement and combat
- Fixed weapon lights and night vision being taken off when you climb.

## Inventory
- Fixed vicinity containers.

## Other Fixes
- Fixed performance issues when start all operations
- Generally improved performance

Patches.Title: New Weapons & AI Settings
Patches.PatchNotes:
## Weapons
- Added the Kel-Tec RFB, the MK-47, the M14, and the Norinco M305, with magazines and parts for each. 

## Gunsmith and inventory
- Gunsmith attachment slots are laid out more consistently and are easier to follow. Also fixed several smaller Gunsmith reported issues from the past.
- Added a split-stack window.

## AI
- Fixed reinforcements on bunker.
- Airdrops call in reinforcement now.
- Convoys are escorted by AI.
- Added Trader and airdrops to other maps. 
- Readded AI Settings -> you can now save&load presets and import/export presets to share with friends!

## Movement and combat
- Refactored code for equipping weapons and gadgets, and both overhand and underhand grenade throws.
- You can now climb onto rocks.
- Fixed some third-person animation issues.
- Mission titles now show when a finished mission can be started again.

## Terminals, trader, and bodies
- Hacking needs a device in your inventory, and each command spends some of its battery. If the device runs out or you take it off, the hack pauses. 
- Updated trader interaction. 

## Outskirts
- Finished the residential area beside the dock, including a loot pass, enemy spawns, and patrol routes.
- Lighting pass on those streets and on the apartment exteriors.
- Added sand and closed gaps along the sea wall, and guard rails where the road meets the water.
- Finished the HAS site and its surroundings: exterior lighting, loot, enemy spawns, patrols, and the missing roof pieces and trim on Outpost C.
- Added the Waiting Station, including an interior wall in the ticket booth.

## Audio
- Smoke grenades now make you and nearby bots cough.
- Weapon handling sounds follow the weapon's weight.
- Interiors on Outskirts, the Quarry, and the Tutorial were rebuilt, including outdoor ambience on Outskirts and new rain.
- Added airstrike sounds.
- Suppressed weapons have new sound tails.
- Updated bullet impact sounds.
- Fixed the sound on the chips and milk eating animations.
- Added the sound for marking resources.

## Graphics and interface
- Added Intel XeSS upscaling and frame generation.
- Fixed AMD FSR frame generation.
- Changing keybinds, or switching frame generation, now warns you that the game has to restart.

Patches.Title: Bug Fixes & Small QoL
Patches.PatchNotes:
## Changes

- Fixed several bugs
- Fixed that actual weapon that killed you is shown in raid summary screen again
- Added a toggle to switch GCPS beeping for resources ON/OFF
- Added guard for item dropping -> never ever item should drop under the ground anymore
- Added LRF animations 
- Improved loading screen times a bit and made world completely load (should be less or no more pop ups after loading screen)
- Made beer now actually being dropped when used :D
- Made key action at the bottom (switch between terminal in hideout etc) clickable as well
- Made Airdrop mission require to trade an item to the in raid trader (provisionally just an ak, later that item will be part of the loot container)
- Updated Laser Dot to be consistently shown across different zoom levels
- Updated Status Icon when inside Gas / Smoke
- Made Inventory UI more performant (nothing major)
